summary: 59-year-old Arvada woman broke her ankle in a hiking fall about 2 miles up the Upper Piney Trail in the Piney River Ranch area; her husband's 1 p.m. 911 call launched a Vail Mountain Rescue Group four-person horseback team (horses and a wrangler provided by Piney Stables); rescuers made contact by 4:30 p.m. and had her out of the field by 6 p.m. to Vail Valley Medical Center.
location: Upper Piney Trail, Piney River Ranch area, north of Vail
responding_agency: Vail Mountain Rescue Group; Eagle County Sheriff's Office; Eagle County Ambulance District
notes: Date = incident/article date; article describes the rescue as 'Wednesday' — 2010-08-11 was a Wednesday (weekday-verified). Found by the run-825 Vail Daily live-browser chunk as an incidental 2010 lead.
